haiku.problem: Trivia 'from 1-10' asks how the Son of Man comes, but the answer 'Riding on a white horse' and 'Hidden in a cloud of smoke' are fine as wrong answers; however the question leads with 'When Jesus taught about the end' which is fine. No clear rule break found.

Wrong answer 'Only the high priest' and 'Only the angels in heaven' are close to the passage's own mention of the angels in 13:32; 'Only the angels in heaven' is false anywhere in the passage, so this is acceptable, but the question reads 'Who did Jesus say knows the day and hour when the Son of Man will return?' which holds nearly the same wording as the card and is fine. No clear problem found.
